metricFamilies.encrypted_completion_monitoring_enabled: 1 when scheduled monitoring is intentionally enabled; 0 distinguishes a reviewed disabled state
metricFamilies.encrypted_completion_success: 1 only after client-side decryption and completion validation
metricFamilies.encrypted_completion_duration_seconds: whole encrypted completion journey duration, not HTTP polling latency
metricFamilies.encrypted_completion_failure_stage: one bounded stage label from the producer descriptor
